name: Do I need to paint or finish my new door after installation?
description: It depends on the door; pre-finished doors require no additional work, while unfinished doors need painting, staining, or sealing.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to paint or finish my new door after installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you need to paint or finish your new door after installation depends on the type of door you purchase. Many doors come pre-finished from the factory, meaning they are ready to be installed without further treatment. If you choose an unfinished wood door, you will need to apply paint, stain, or a protective sealant to protect it from moisture and wear, and to match your home's aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: It depends on the door; pre-finished doors require no additional work, while unfinished doors need painting, staining, or sealing.
